extracted.name: Lemon Herb Butter
extracted.description: Unsalted butter combined with lemon zest, rosemary, thyme, and sage makes a nice lemon herb butter spread for rolls or a flavorful ingredient for cooking.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 cup unsalted butter at room temperature
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Mash butter in a bowl until smooth and creamy.
Mix lemon zest, lemon juice, rosemary, thyme, sage, salt, and black pepper into butter until thoroughly combined.
